Brief facts of the prosecution case is that, The accused No.2 M/s Japan Mannequin company a dissolved partnership firm and it was owned by accused No.1 and 3 and it was engaged in manufacturing mannequins i.e. life-size dolls used for displaying garments in ready-made show rooms which is subject to the payment of central excise duty.

Subsequent to the searches conducted by the officials of the Directorate General of Anti-Evasion, Bangalore Regional Unit on 21.01.1993,
the department had made out an offence case against the company for the evasion of central excise duty amount of Rs.25,74,978/- for goods worth of Rs.1,07,59,808/- on 16.07.1993.

The matter was adjudicated by the then Collector of Central Excise-II, Bangalore Mr. M.V. Reddy, IRS and he has passed order on 13.12.1994.
3.

During the period between September and November 1994 the accused No.1 to 3 entered into a criminal conspiracy to cheat the department of Central Excise in the matter of payment of central excise duty.

In pursuance of the said criminal conspiracy, accused No.1 and 3 further conspired with accused No.4 to 6 and pursuant to this, accused No.1 and 3 have arranged the swearing of affidavits containing false information by accused No.4 and 6 and others, knowing fully well that the contents therein were false and then dishonestly and fraudulently got them filed before the then Adjudicating Collector of Central Excise-II, Bangalore through accused No.5 and induced him to believe such affidavits were genuine.

Based on these false affidavits, the matter was adjudicated in favour of the accused No.2 Firm causing a wrongful gain of Rs.4,96,006/- being the duty leviable on the products supposedly manufacture by a fictitious unit that had been floated by the partners of accused No.2 firm i.e. accused No.1 and 3.
4.

Further accused No.1 and 3, with a dishonest and fraudulent intention to cheat the government,
with the active connivance of accused No.5 showed on record as accused No.5 was running an independent unit in the name and style of M/s Favourite Mannequin company at No.27, K. Kamaraj Road, Bangalore between the period 1988 and 1990.

The accused persons were fully aware that the said company was never functioning at the given address and they knowingly and intentionally arranged for affidavits containing false information from the workers of accused No.2 M/s Japan Mannequin Company stating inter-alia that they were working for the said company at the stated address with the sole intention of deceive the then adjudicating Collector of Central Excise-II,
Bangalore to believing that the said M/s Favourite Mannequin company was an independent unit.

Hence, accused persons have criminally conspired, created false documents and used them as genuine and presented before the adjudicating authority, knowing fully well the documents used by them were false and cheated the Government of India to the extent of Rs.4,96,006/-and thereby committed the offence punishable u/Sec.120 B r/w 420, 468 and 471 of IPC and the substantive offences thereof.

5. After receipt of the charge sheet, this court took the cognizance of the offences alleged against the accused No.1 to 6 and the accused persons secured by issuing summons and they were enlarged on bail.
